method: SMS2 Pairwise Align Protein, BLOSUM62, gap opening 12, gap extension 2

records.label: Case 01
records.preparation: Use the supplied Case 01 protein and the workshop A*01:01:01:01 reference.

records.label: Case 02 — independent CDS
records.preparation: Use the verified translation of the independent CDS before its first stop. This pair does not apply to the genomic input.

records.label: Case 04
records.preparation: Use the CDS-verified amino-acid segment before the stop. The terminal marker in the original protein file is excluded.

records.label: Case 05 — supplied short protein
records.preparation: The alignment covers the known amino-acid prefix only. The original terminal X remains unresolved and is outside this alignment. Use the unmodified short sequence when verifying its exact NetSurfP archive.

records.label: Case 05 — supplied CDS
records.preparation: Use the independent CDS translation. Treat the short protein file as a separate record.

records.label: Case 06
records.preparation: Use the supplied Case 06 protein and the workshop A*01:01:01:01 reference.

records.label: HLA-B demonstration
records.preparation: Separate practice pair for an unresolved or unmatched case. The second input is an artificial demonstration sequence.
